1.

Just as I am, without a straw Of my own ground to build upon, Only on that ground, that Thou for me Hast died and Thyself didst invite us to Thee.

2.

Just as I am, ere I have Accomplished what eternally was vain— To cleanse myself from one spot— To Thee, whose blood alone doth this.

3.

Just as I am in this moment, So poor, cold, and evil in nature, To find all that I lack, In blessed abundance with Thee.

4.

Just as I am, Thou dost rejoice to see Me come and give me all, Forgive, cleanse, heal me; I believe Thy word, and safe in Thee.

5.

Just as I am, Thou hast loved me, For Thou hast bought me, as I am; Thou didst well know how evil I was, When Thou didst bear my sins here.

6.

Just as I am, yet now I believe And would praise Thy great love, Whose breadth and length and depth and height I shall sing in eternal joy.
